comment: Paths that cannot change what the server does with customer data, nor the consent, upload, source, key or account UI in front of it: docs, tests, static media and the public landing, benchmark and changelog pages. Every other tracked path, this file and gate-surface.mjs included, is the gate surface. Shipped code on this list may not fetch, read process.env, run on the server-only side, or import supabase, node: modules, shared/ gate code or the grant, admission, intake and release-store modules (release-gate-check.test.mjs); that test, its vitest wrapper and the developer setup and safety contract under public/developer/ are surface, so weakening them moves the digest. Widening this list changes the digest, so it needs a new founder release once. docs/adr/0006-release-continuity-by-gate-surface.md.
